subject: Env activation: ownership matrix, gated prerequisites & access runway
messages:
From: Edward Lin <edward.lin@vitahealth.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Env activation: ownership matrix, gated prerequisites & access runway

Hi Jonas / team,

Thanks for the onboarding kickoff yesterday. Before we lock a kickoff time, our infra team asked for a single canonical checklist of what Redwood needs from us to activate the private deployment (VPC + on-prem edge). High level asks we need to confirm:

- AWS account IDs (dev/prod), required IAM roles and exact names
- CIDR ranges / peering requirements and whether you need cross-account route tables
- Egress IP allowlist (we need to reserve NAT IPs)
- KMS key metadata (key arn, rotation policy) and whether an external HSM is required
- Service account / machine user for automated health checks (SCIM/LDAP integration scope)
- Required ports and ephemeral/steady connections to your control plane
- Evidence you need for our security intake (SOC-2 artifacts, logging endpoints, sample audit events)

Can you send a single document we can track and assign owners against? I've looped in Ben and Marissa for procurement and ops alignment.

Also attaching a preliminary network diagram (attached) and the contact for our on-call infra: it@vitahealth.com.

Thanks,
Edward

--
Edward Lin
Infrastructure Lead, VitaHealth
edward.lin@vitahealth.com
+1 415 555 0198

Attachment: vita_network_diagram.pdf (diagram, 1 page, referenced)

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Edward Lin <edward.lin@vitahealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 17:03:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Env activation: ownership matrix, gated prerequisites & access runway

Edward — thanks, this is exactly the right set of questions. I've drafted an onboarding matrix that maps each Redwood prerequisite to a VitaHealth owner, suggested timeline, and an ops checklist for validation.

Short answers to your bullet list while the matrix moves through your team:
- AWS accounts: we need both the account IDs and two roles (Redwood-Deployer, Redwood-ReadOnly). Names are listed in the attached matrix.
- CIDRs: we recommend a /16 for primary VPC and separate /20s per edge site. You can provide current CIDRs; we can advise on overlap and NAT.
- Egress IP: provide static NAT IPs if you have them; otherwise we can allocate a published egress pool and request a permit list from your firewall team.
- KMS: a customer-managed key (CMK) in the account is preferred. Rotation weekly is fine but please share the arn. HSM optional — only required for FIPS mandates.
- Service account: we ask for a machine user with two keys and a least-privilege policy which I'll include in the matrix.
- Ports: 443 outbound to control-plane endpoints, SSH only to jump hosts (if enabled). Details in the matrix.
- Security artifacts: we'll need sample syslog/audit events, retention requirements, and the SOC-2 attestation PDF if available.

I'm attaching: redwood_onboarding_matrix.xlsx (ownership + gating checklist) and a short validation runbook at the bottom of the sheet. Please review, assign the owners column, and drop the Drive link to any existing security docs. Once owners are assigned we can schedule the 90-minute tech kickoff.

Proposed next step: Ben, can you coordinate a Monday or Tuesday slot next week for the kickoff?

Cheers,
Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Director, Private Deployments | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood_onboarding_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet, 3 sheets: prerequisites, owners, validation runbook)
